t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Pick the same set of colours until they start to give lower numbers and then switch to the other colours.

vb_textbox.text: Within each colour pair one will have a higher reward (4+ for 1x), so keep selecting these colours. Occasionally, these will switch so if you start getting lower rewards (1 or 2 for 1x) swap to picking the other colour in that pair. Ignore the occasional zero values. 3 seems to fall under both high and low reward categories so maybe do not make decisions solely based on receiving 3 mushrooms.
